title: Buttoning
offscreen: It's already a hands-on activity: repeat it over the following days without presenting it again; the child chooses it on their own.

materials.label: A shirt or cardigan with big buttons, laid out on the table

steps.text: Hold the button with two fingers and the buttonhole with two others.
Push half the button through the hole, then pull it through from the other side.
Do this for all the buttons, from top to bottom.
Then undo them all, from bottom to top.

levels.control: If a button is in the wrong hole, the shirt has a crooked fold: you can see it.
levels.observe: After a few days, try with the shirt on: that's the step towards dressing on their own.

intro.bo: {nome}, this one is done with your hands, not on the tablet. Call a grown-up and I'll watch you.
intro.pilu: {nome}, you need real objects for this one. A grown-up shows you once, then it's your turn.
intro.tango: {nome}! Real work! Call a grown-up: first you watch, then you do it. I won't touch anything, promise.

outro.bo: You worked on your own, {nome}. Let's put everything away, so you'll find it again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Everything goes back in its place, {nome}: that's part of the work.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, shall we put everything away? I'll... I'll watch.
